{{Quote|Apparently, Master Gnost-Dural took as many Jedi as he could find and established a hidden colony on the planet with the help of civilian volunteers.|[[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:TLC" />}}
The '''Ossus Colonization Initiative''' was a colonization effort led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] to seek refuge in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] ancient [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], isolated from the galactic community. The project lasted for years until it was ended with the [[Invasion of Ossus]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
